WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.transref,
    tr.tradekind,
    AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx
    ON tx.transreg = s.transref
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind
), overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS mean_pair_avg
  FROM pair_averages
), kept_pairs AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_anlycount,
         p.avg_anlycount - m.mean_pair_avg AS margin_over_mean
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
  WHERE p.avg_anlycount > m.mean_pair_avg
), type_averages AS (
  SELECT tradekind,
         AVG(avg_anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
         AVG(margin_over_mean) AS avg_margin_over_mean
  FROM kept_pairs
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT tradekind,
       avg_anlycount,
       avg_margin_over_mean,
       avg_anlycount / AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS relative_to_type_mean
FROM type_averages;

assumptions.assumption: The overall mean is the unweighted mean across transaction and trader type pair averages; each pair average ignores NULL analyst counts. Pairs with no non-NULL analyst counts therefore do not contribute.
